00155 void VoicerUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int /*channel*/) throw()
00156 {   
00157     if(shouldStopAllEvents() == true) initEvents();
00158     
00159     if(midiMessages.isEmpty() == true)
00160     {
00161         const ScopedLock sl(lock);
00162         SpawnBaseUGenInternal::processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, -1);
00163     }
00164     else
00165     {
00166         const int blockSize = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00167         MidiBuffer::Iterator iter(midiMessages);
00168         MidiMessage message(0xf4, 0.0);
00169         
00170         int samplePos = 0;
00171         int startSample = 0;
00172         
00173         const int numChannels = getNumChannels();
00174         const int midiChannel = midiChannel_;
00175         
00176         while(iter.getNextEvent(message, samplePos) && (samplePos < blockSize))
00177         {
00178             const ScopedLock sl(lock);
00179                 
00180             if(samplePos < 0) samplePos = 0;
00181             
00182             const int numSamples = samplePos - startSample;
00183         
00184             if(numSamples > 0)
00185             {
00186                 UGen::setBlockSize(numSamples);
00187                 
00188                 for(int channel = 0; channel < numChannels; channel++)
00189                 {
00190                     bufferData[channel] = proxies[channel]->getSampleData() + startSample;
00191                 }
00192                 
00193                 mixer.prepareForBlock(numSamples, blockID + startSample);
00194                 mixer.setOutputs(bufferData, numSamples, numChannels);
00195                 mixer.processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID + startSample, -1);                
00196             }
00197             
00198             startSample = samplePos;
00199             
00200             if(message.isForChannel(midiChannel))
00201             {
00202                 if(message.isNoteOnOrOff())
00203                 {
00204                     const int midiNote = message.getNoteNumber();
00205                     const int velocity = message.getVelocity();
00206                                         
00207                     if(velocity > 0)
00208                     {
00209                         if(numVoices_ > 0)
00210                         {
00211                             const int voicesUsed = countNonstealingVoices();
00212                             if(voicesUsed >= numVoices_)
00213                             {
00214                                 UGen& stealee = chooseStealee();
00215                                 
00216                                 if(stealee.isNotNull())
00217                                 {
00218                                     stealee.userData = stealingUserData;
00219                                     stealee.steal(forcedSteal_);
00220                                 }
00221                             }
00222                         }
00223                         
00224                         // stop double notes, AU lab was sending two ons but one off 
00225                         stealNote(midiChannel, midiNote, false, true); 
00226                         
00227                         UGen newEvent = spawnEvent(*this, currentEventIndex++, midiChannel, midiNote, velocity);
00228                         newEvent.userData = createUserData(midiChannel, midiNote);
00229                         events <<= newEvent;
00230                         mixer = Mix(&events, false);
00231                     }
00232                     else
00233                     {
00234                         UGen& releasee = chooseReleasee(midiChannel, midiNote);
00235                         if(releasee.isNotNull()) releasee.release();
00236                     }
00237                 }
00238                 else if(message.isController())
00239                 {
00240                     setController(message.getControllerNumber(), 
00241                                   message.getControllerValue() / 127.f);
00242                 }
00243                 else if(message.isPitchWheel())
00244                 {
00245                     setPitchWheel(jlimit(-8191, 8191, message.getPitchWheelValue() - 8192) / 8191.f);
00246                 }
00247                 else if(message.isChannelPressure())
00248                 {
00249                     setChannelPressure(message.getChannelPressureValue() / 127.f);
00250                 }
00251                 else if(message.isAftertouch())
00252                 {
00253                     setKeyPressure(message.getNoteNumber(), 
00254                                    message.getAfterTouchValue() / 127.f);
00255                 }
00256                 else if(message.isProgramChange())
00257                 {
00258                     setProgram(message.getProgramChangeNumber());
00259                 }
00260                 else if(message.isAllNotesOff())
00261                 {
00262                     initEvents();
00263                 }
00264             }
00265         }
00266         
00267         const ScopedLock sl(lock);
00268         
00269         const int numSamples = blockSize - startSample;
00270         
00271         if(numSamples > 0)
00272         {
00273             UGen::setBlockSize(numSamples);
00274             
00275             for(int channel = 0; channel < numChannels; channel++)
00276             {
00277                 bufferData[channel] = proxies[channel]->getSampleData() + startSample;
00278             }
00279             
00280             mixer.prepareForBlock(numSamples, blockID + startSample);
00281             mixer.setOutputs(bufferData, numSamples, numChannels);
00282             mixer.processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID + startSample, -1);
00283         }
00284         
00285         UGen::setBlockSize(blockSize);
00286         
00287         midiMessages.clear();
00288     }   
00289 }

00291 void VoicerUGenInternal::handleIncomingMidiMessage (MidiInput* source, const MidiMessage& message) throw()
00292 {
00293     if(message.isForChannel(midiChannel_) == false) return;
00294     if(message.isNoteOnOrOff() == false)            return;
00295         
00296     const ScopedLock sl(lock);
00297     sendMidiNote(message.getChannel(), message.getNoteNumber(), message.getVelocity());
00298 }

00300 void VoicerUGenInternal::sendMidiBuffer(MidiBuffer const& midiMessagesToAdd) throw()
00301 {
00302     const ScopedLock sl(lock);
00303     
00304     if(midiMessagesToAdd.isEmpty() == false)
00305     {               
00306         midiMessages.addEvents(midiMessagesToAdd, 0, -1, 0);
00307     }
00308 }
